svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor 283 x 160.4 mm; side walls 30 mm; end stop 40 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark one blank: floor in the middle, a wall on each long edge

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a 12 mm tab at the stop end, and the stop on one short

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edge, 157.4 mm wide so it fits between the walls.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the slot in the stop before bending: C5 36 x 22 mm, centred

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 43 mm toward the front, 7.35 to 29.35 mm above the floor's top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (C25 on the centre line, H70 43 mm toward the back.)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 3 mm relief holes where bend lines cross.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bend the stop up 90 degrees, then the walls (inside radius 1.5),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: then fold each tab round the outside of the stop.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 3.3 mm through tab and stop, 6 mm in from the wall, 8 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 22 mm above the floor; rivet with heads inside the frame.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lip: fold the open end of the floor up 4 mm; cut three

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 14 mm notches in it, centred 41.75 mm and 8.25 mm toward

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the front and 58.25 mm toward the back, for the screw heads.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stick the "C5 ONLY" decal on the stop beside the slot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: inside width 157.4 mm; stop square to the floor.
